claims: WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 took place on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 took place at The Factory at The District in Chesterfield, Missouri.
WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 was the sixth annual event.
WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 was separated from WrestleMania week.
WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 streamed on YouTube and Netflix.
Tony D'Angelo defeated Joe Hendry (c), Ethan Page, and Ricky Saints in a Fatal 4-Way for the NXT Championship at WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026.
Jacy Jayne (c) defeated Kendal Grey and Lola Vice in a Triple Threat for the NXT Women's Championship at WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026.
Myles Borne (c) defeated Johnny Gargano for the NXT North American Championship at WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026.
Tatum Paxley (c) defeated Blake Monroe for the NXT Women's North American Championship at WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026.
Birthright defeated Hank, Tank, EK Prosper, Shiloh Hill, and Wren Sinclair in a Mixed 10-Person Tag on the pre-show at WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026.
WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 was the first time an NXT event streamed on YouTube in the U.S.
WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 streamed on YouTube in the U.S. following the end of the Peacock agreement.
Netflix hosted WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 in other regions.
